user.title: Connect to Cummins Connect Cloud
user.description: How do you want to sign in?

credentials.title: Sign in to Cummins Connect Cloud
credentials.description: Enter your Cummins Connect Cloud username and password. These are used once to sign in and are not stored — only the resulting session token is saved.

token.title: Connect with a refresh token
token.description: Advanced / fallback option. Paste the refresh token produced by running `tools/bootstrap_login.py` on your laptop (see the repository README) — useful if signing in with username/password above doesn't work.

asset.title: Choose a generator
asset.description: More than one generator was found on this account. Pick the one to add now — run setup again to add another.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Cummins Connect Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Your Cummins Connect Cloud session is no longer valid. Enter your username and password to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected — check your username/password (or refresh token), or it may have expired.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cummins Connect Cloud. Check your network connection and try again.
error.no_assets: No generators were found on this Cummins account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
